Hi Sam,

Thanks again for choosing Redwood — excited to get StrataHealth ramped. To make the onboarding most efficient, we typically run a 90-minute joint session: 45 minutes console walkthrough (roles, routes, cost controls) + 30 minutes API enablement (sandbox keys, example integration) + 15 minutes Q&A and next steps.

Can you confirm which of these windows work for your team? I included a simple timezone matrix attachment with equivalent local times.

Proposed slots (PDT / UTC):
- Tue Aug 25, 10:00–11:30 PDT (17:00–18:30 UTC)
- Wed Aug 26, 08:00–09:30 PDT (15:00–16:30 UTC)
- Thu Aug 27, 13:00–14:30 PDT (20:00–21:30 UTC)

If none of these fit, tell me 2–3 preferred windows and we'll adjust. Also let me know if you want the session recorded and whether we should invite your engineering lead — we can split the API deep dive into a follow-up if they'd prefer.

Prep: I attached a short agenda + timezone_matrix. If you can share the email of your primary engineer (or add them to this thread) we'll pre-provision a sandbox token.

Thanks,
Vivek
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
